en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an aerial view of a modernist, multi‑storey hotel complex on a curved mountain road surrounded by dense forest. The front caption at the bottom reads "Pécs" on the left and "Üdülőszálló a Mecseken" on the right. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back with multilingual printed title: "Erholungshotel im Gebirge Mecsek / Hôtel de récréation aux montagnes de Mecsek / Hotel of Recreation in the Mecsek Montains" and Hungarian postal instructions, plus a Budapest publisher imprint.
